reserveReview.rationale: The October 1, 2026 issuer report discloses R$6,253,635 of LFTs, R$628,835 of bank balance, and R$12,471,902 of repos, totaling R$19,354,372. Its published percentages are 32.31%, 3.25%, and 64.44%. All reserves are reported in a segregated account at Banco XP S.A. owned by BRL1 CONSORTIUM S.A. The issuer reconciles them internally to 17,381,384.54 BRL1 at Polygon block 94777137, stated timestamp October 1, 2026 16:07:25 UTC, and reports 111.35% collateralization. The report is internally prepared, board-approved and explicitly unaudited; verified confidence refers to the fully itemized primary disclosure, not independent assurance. The current issuer page footer links this report; its body still links an older report. Publication date is unestablished. A pinned archival eth_call at block 94777137 independently returns 17,381,384.54 BRL1 totalSupply, and the block header is timestamped 16:07:26 UTC, one second after the issuer-stated observation. This checks the reported liability quantity, not the off-chain bank balances.
